verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm the API supports both sandbox and live environments with OAuth-based auth for each, indicating a sandbox exists for testing without touching production data. However, there is no detail on how sandbox data is isolated, how to provision/reset a sandbox, or any confirmation that all workflow/report features (watchlist, NFC, biometric) are fully testable in sandbox mode. missing for 10: explicit sandbox provisioning/reset instructions, confirmation of feature parity in sandbox, independent/hands-on corroboration.
